Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. This is a dedicated infrastructure and reliability engineering role focused on scaling resilient, secure, and cost-efficient systems across cloud providers—supporting a platform already processing 50+ PB of data and 600K+ hours of video. Who You Are - 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure operating production systems at scale. - Proven experience managing large Kubernetes (k8s) deployments at scale in production—including multi-cluster operations, node pool autoscaling, cluster upgrades, workload isolation, and hardening (Amazon EKS and Azure AKS strongly preferred). - Hands-on experience designing, provisioning, and operating multi-cloud deployments in production across multiple cloud providers (AWS and Azure strongly preferred), including cross-cloud networking, identity, and storage architectures. - Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, or equivalent) and declarative, reproducible environment management. - Experience designing, maintaining, and securing CI/CD pipelines, container builds, and automated deployment/rollback workflows (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions). - Deep understanding of cloud networking, storage, and distributed systems fundamentals—including VPC design, DNS, load balancing, ingress, object storage lifecycle, and high-throughput data infrastructure. - Hands-on experience with observability and reliability engineering: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO/SLI management (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana). - Strong cloud security and compliance foundation, including IAM/RBAC least-privilege, workload/pod identity, KMS and secrets management, network segmentation, secret/vulnerability scanning, and audit logging. - Proven track record in production incident response, on-call operations, root-cause analysis, and disaster recovery. - Strong automation and scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, or Go) for infrastructure tooling, CI/CD automation, and operational workflows. - Experience with cloud cost management (FinOps), capacity planning, autoscaling, right-sizing, and storage/compute optimization at multi-petabyte scale. What You'll Do - Manage, scale, upgrade, and harden large production Kubernetes (k8s) deployments across EKS and AKS—owning cluster topology, node pools, autoscaling, ingress, and workload isolation for high-throughput data and physical AI workloads. - Design, provision, and operate resilient multi-cloud deployments and core infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and other cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code. - Build, optimize, and secure CI/CD pipelines, container registries, environment provisioning, and zero-downtime deployment automation to improve deployment velocity and safety. - Architect and improve end-to-end observability across monitoring, logging, alerting, distributed tracing, and capacity management. - Define and enforce service-level objectives (SLOs), incident response playbooks, automated remediation, and disaster recovery procedures. - Implement and maintain cloud and Kubernetes security controls—including IAM/pod identity, KMS encryption, secrets management, network policies, vulnerability management, and compliance logging. - Monitor and optimize infrastructure costs across cloud services, Kubernetes workloads, networking, and large-scale object storage through right-sizing, autoscaling, lifecycle policies, and capacity planning. - Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Kubernetes, cloud networking, storage, compute, and CI/CD systems. - Participate in an on-call rotation and take ownership of diagnosing, mitigating, and preventing production incidents. - Partner with application, data, and ML/robotics engineering teams to provide self-service infrastructure patterns and remove operational bottlenecks. - Participate in infrastructure, Terraform, and pipeline reviews and raise the operational and security bar through clear, practical feedback. - Own complex, ambiguous infrastructure initiatives end-to-end—from architecture and implementation through production operation—and continuously improve deployment lead time, reliability, incident recovery time (MTTR), resource utilization, and infrastructure cost per workload.  Perks -
